title: 煙氣酸性氣體洗滌~Acid-gas scrubbing of flue gas
focus: 用酸性氣體質量、化學當量與液氣接觸評估洗滌流程~Assess acid-gas scrubbing through mass load, chemical equivalents and gas-liquid contact
summary: 本課以「用酸性氣體質量、化學當量與液氣接觸評估洗滌流程」為主軸，依序處理酸性氣體負荷與成分、循環液與氣體接觸、循環泵與輸送能量、排污水鹽分負荷、量測校正與反應證據。十個單元各包含機制、算例、量測驗證及失效診斷；數值均為明示的原創教學假設，不能直接用作工程設計、排放限值或設備設定。~This course focuses on Assess acid-gas scrubbing through mass load, chemical equivalents and gas-liquid contact, progressing through Acid-gas loading and species, Recirculating-liquid contact, Recirculation-pump energy, Blowdown salt load, Calibration and reaction evidence. Ten units each address mechanism, worked calculation, measurement verification and failure diagnosis. Numbers are explicit original teaching assumptions, not design values, emission limits or equipment settings.
history: 這項技術的學習脈絡由單一設備處理，逐步擴展至物質與能量收支、監測品質和生命週期比較。本課將官方方法文件作為查核入口，並以獨立編寫的假想數據練習；參考文件的年代與地區不代表其規範在所有場址適用。~The learning progression expands from individual treatment equipment to mass and energy balances, monitoring quality and lifecycle comparison. Official method documents provide verification starting points while independently authored hypothetical data support practice; a document date or jurisdiction does not establish applicability to every site.

units.title: 酸性氣體負荷與成分~Acid-gas loading and species
units.mechanism: 不同酸性氣體有不同反應當量與溶解性，先分種記錄入口負荷。 氣體污染質量流率須用同一標準溫壓與乾濕基的氣量、濃度相乘。~Acid gases differ in reaction equivalents and solubility; inventory inlet loading by species. Gas pollutant mass rate requires flow and concentration at the same reference conditions and moisture basis.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：乾標準氣量 Q=10000 Nm³/h；濃度 C=20 mg/Nm³。公式 m=Q*C/1e6，計算得 0.2 kg/h。適用邊界：Nm³ 的定義需另註明；本題比較固定基準，未套用氧校正。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Dry standard gas flow Q=10000 Nm³/h; concentration C=20 mg/Nm³. Formula m=Q*C/1e6 gives 0.2 kg/h. Applicability: Define the normal-volume reference; this comparison fixes that basis and applies no oxygen correction.
units.verify: 針對「酸性氣體負荷與成分」，查驗溫壓、含濕率及濃度報表欄位，再核對煙道流速與面積。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Acid-gas loading and species, Check temperature, pressure, moisture and concentration-report bases, then verify duct velocity and area. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 標準氣量和實際體積流量混乘會系統性偏差。 在「酸性氣體負荷與成分」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Multiplying standard concentration by actual volume flow creates systematic bias. Mark where this error can enter the Acid-gas loading and species flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 任何單位標成 m³ 的氣量都可直接乘 Nm³ 基準濃度。~Any flow labelled m³ can directly multiply a concentration based on Nm³.
units.practice: 只將 Q 改成 12000 Nm³/h，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.2 變成 0.24 kg/h。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only Q to 12000 Nm³/h, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 0.2 to 0.24 kg/h. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 中和反應當量~Neutralization equivalents
units.mechanism: 先用已平衡的反應式建立理論當量，再將副反應與未利用藥劑列為額外證據。 化學計量給理論反應需求，實際投加還受混合、反應溫度及副反應限制。~Start from a balanced reaction and treat side reactions and unused reagent as separate evidence. Stoichiometry gives theoretical demand; real dosing also depends on mixing, temperature and side reactions.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：目標反應物 n=100 mol/h；理論摩爾比 s=1；假設投加比 R=1.10。公式 n_reagent=n*s*R，計算得 110 mol/h。適用邊界：抽象單一反應模型，比例僅供教學，不能直接作現場加藥量。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Target reactant n=100 mol/h; stoichiometric ratio s=1; assumed feed ratio R=1.10. Formula n_reagent=n*s*R gives 110 mol/h. Applicability: An abstract single-reaction model; ratios are teaching inputs, not field reagent settings.
units.verify: 針對「中和反應當量」，用進出口物種分析追蹤反應與未反應藥劑，分別報去除量和逸出量。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Neutralization equivalents, Track reactants and unreacted reagent at inlet and outlet; report removal and slip separately. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 過量投加可能增加藥劑逸出或殘渣，而非繼續改善去除。 在「中和反應當量」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Excess feed can increase reagent slip or residue instead of improving removal. Mark where this error can enter the Neutralization equivalents flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 藥劑投加越多，淨環境效益必定越大。~More reagent always gives greater net environmental benefit.
units.practice: 只將 R 改成 1.25，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 110 變成 125 mol/h。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only R to 1.25, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 110 to 125 mol/h. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 循環液與氣體接觸~Recirculating-liquid contact
units.mechanism: 噴淋與填料潤濕決定有效接觸，總循環量正常不代表每個區域都均勻。 液氣比描述平均接觸供給，去除仍受溶解、反應與填料潤濕影響。~Spray and packing wetting determine effective contact; normal total circulation does not guarantee uniform zones. Liquid-to-gas ratio describes mean contacting supply; removal also depends on solubility, reaction and wetting.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：循環液量 L=12 m³/h；氣量 G=6000 m³/h。公式 L_over_G=1000*L/G，計算得 2 L/m³。適用邊界：流量比教學模型，不是洗滌塔設計值；未求傳質單元數。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Recirculating liquid L=12 m³/h; gas flow G=6000 m³/h. Formula L_over_G=1000*L/G gives 2 L/m³. Applicability: A flow-ratio teaching model, not a scrubber design value; transfer units are not calculated.
units.verify: 針對「循環液與氣體接觸」，核對液體分布、噴嘴、循環濃度與壓降，不只檢查泵流量。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Recirculating-liquid contact, Check liquid distribution, nozzles, recirculating concentration and pressure drop, not pump flow alone. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 液體旁流造成乾區，名目液氣比正常也可能去除不良。 在「循環液與氣體接觸」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Liquid channeling creates dry zones even at a normal nominal liquid-to-gas ratio. Mark where this error can enter the Recirculating-liquid contact flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 只要液氣比相同，任何填料與化學條件下的去除率都相同。~Equal liquid-to-gas ratios guarantee equal removal for any packing and chemistry.
units.practice: 只將 G 改成 7500 m³/h，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 2 變成 1.6 L/m³。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only G to 7500 m³/h, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 2 to 1.6 L/m³. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 洗滌塔壓降與阻塞~Scrubber pressure drop and obstruction
units.mechanism: 填料結垢、液泛與除霧器堵塞可能呈現不同差壓分布，需分段測量。 差壓反映測點間總阻力，須配合同時的流量與氣體狀態判讀。~Scaling, flooding and demister blockage can produce different pressure profiles, requiring sectional measurements. Differential pressure reflects resistance between taps and needs concurrent flow and gas-condition data.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：量測前壓 p1=1800 Pa；後壓 p2=600 Pa。公式 dp=p1-p2，計算得 1200 Pa。適用邊界：相同基準壓力與測點；單一差壓不能區分所有堵塞或洩漏原因。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Upstream pressure p1=1800 Pa; downstream pressure p2=600 Pa. Formula dp=p1-p2 gives 1200 Pa. Applicability: Common pressure reference and specified taps; one differential cannot identify every blockage or leak.
units.verify: 針對「洗滌塔壓降與阻塞」，檢查導壓管、零點和測點位置，再把差壓與流量趨勢一起畫出。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Scrubber pressure drop and obstruction, Inspect impulse lines, zero and tap locations, then plot pressure drop with flow. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 導壓管堵塞可能被誤判為設備阻塞。 在「洗滌塔壓降與阻塞」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~A blocked impulse line can be mistaken for equipment blockage. Mark where this error can enter the Scrubber pressure drop and obstruction flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 只要差壓上升，就能確定濾材一定破損。~A higher differential pressure proves the filter medium is damaged.
units.practice: 只將 p1 改成 2200 Pa，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 1200 變成 1600 Pa。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only p1 to 2200 Pa, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 1200 to 1600 Pa. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 循環泵與輸送能量~Recirculation-pump energy
units.mechanism: 循環液輸送需要克服高度與管路損失，泵耗應和處理效能一起比較。 泵功率需包含靜揚程、摩擦和局部損失的總揚程；效率隨運轉點變動。~Recirculation overcomes elevation and line losses; compare pumping demand with treatment performance. Pump duty uses total head including static lift, friction and local losses; efficiency varies with operating point.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：水量 Q=0.01 m³/s；總揚程 H=15 m；ρ=1000 kg/m³；g=9.81 m/s²；η=0.65。公式 P=rho*g*Q*H/eta/1000，計算得 2.26385 kW。適用邊界：清水密度與固定效率概念估算，不替代含固體泵選型或防爆設計。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Water flow Q=0.01 m³/s; total head H=15 m; ρ=1000 kg/m³; g=9.81 m/s²; η=0.65. Formula P=rho*g*Q*H/eta/1000 gives 2.26385 kW. Applicability: A water-density, fixed-efficiency estimate, not solids-pump selection or hazardous-area design.
units.verify: 針對「循環泵與輸送能量」，同時讀取液位、流量、壓力和電力，核對實際工作點。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Recirculation-pump energy, Read levels, flow, pressure and power together to verify the actual operating point. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 管道堵塞會提高阻力，固定額定功率不代表固定流量。 在「循環泵與輸送能量」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Pipe blockage raises resistance; a fixed motor rating does not imply fixed flow. Mark where this error can enter the Recirculation-pump energy flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 馬達額定功率相同的泵在任何管線都提供相同流量。~Pumps with the same motor rating deliver the same flow through any pipe system.
units.practice: 只將 H 改成 20 m，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 2.26385 變成 3.01846 kW。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only H to 20 m, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 2.26385 to 3.01846 kW. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 排放濃度與去除率~Emission concentration and removal
units.mechanism: 以同一物種同一基準比較進出口，低入口負荷時不以百分比獨斷效果。 同基準入口與出口的差可估濃度去除率；氣量變動時應改比質量流率。~Compare the same species and reference basis at inlet and outlet; removal percentage alone is weak evidence at low inlet load. Matched-basis inlet and outlet values give concentration removal; use mass rates when gas flow changes.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：入口濃度 Cin=100 mg/m³；出口 Cout=12 mg/m³。公式 eta=(Cin-Cout)/Cin*100，計算得 88 %。適用邊界：同一乾濕基、溫壓及流量；不以去除率取代出口排放判定。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Inlet concentration Cin=100 mg/m³; outlet Cout=12 mg/m³. Formula eta=(Cin-Cout)/Cin*100 gives 88 %. Applicability: Matched moisture, temperature, pressure and flow; removal percentage does not replace an outlet-emission assessment.
units.verify: 針對「排放濃度與去除率」，同步採入口與出口並校正相同基準，另核對出口量測不確定度。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Emission concentration and removal, Sample inlet and outlet simultaneously on the same basis and assess outlet measurement uncertainty. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 不同基準直接相減或用低於檢出限數值當零，會誇大效率。 在「排放濃度與去除率」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Subtracting different bases or treating nondetects as zero exaggerates efficiency. Mark where this error can enter the Emission concentration and removal flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 去除率很高就能證明出口濃度符合任何排放標準。~High removal efficiency proves compliance with every outlet-emission limit.
units.practice: 只將 Cout 改成 20 mg/m³，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 88 變成 80 %。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only Cout to 20 mg/m³, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 88 to 80 %. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 排污水鹽分負荷~Blowdown salt load
units.mechanism: 被捕集的酸形成液相鹽分，需追蹤排污水處理，不能把捕集等同污染消失。 流量與濃度共同決定質量負荷；mg/L 乘 m³/d 後除以 1000 得 kg/d。~Captured acids form dissolved salts; track blowdown treatment rather than treating capture as disappearance. Flow and concentration jointly determine mass loading; divide mg/L times m³/d by 1000 to obtain kg/d.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：流量 Q=120 m³/d；濃度 C=250 mg/L。公式 load=Q*C/1000，計算得 30 kg/d。適用邊界：流量與樣品代表同一時間窗；單點濃度不能代替流量加權平均。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Flow Q=120 m³/d; concentration C=250 mg/L. Formula load=Q*C/1000 gives 30 kg/d. Applicability: Flow and concentration represent the same time window; a grab value does not replace a flow-weighted mean.
units.verify: 針對「排污水鹽分負荷」，對齊流量計與採樣時間，以分時段 Q×C 加總，核對總量與單位。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Blowdown salt load, Align flow-meter and sampling timestamps; sum interval Q×C and check totals and units. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 只比較濃度會把稀釋當成污染質量已移除。 在「排污水鹽分負荷」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~A concentration-only comparison can mistake dilution for pollutant removal. Mark where this error can enter the Blowdown salt load flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 出流水濃度下降就代表污染總量一定下降。~A lower effluent concentration always means a lower total pollutant load.
units.practice: 只將 Q 改成 150 m³/d，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 30 變成 37.5 kg/d。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only Q to 150 m³/d, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 30 to 37.5 kg/d. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 水分蒸發與補水~Evaporation and makeup water
units.mechanism: 高溫煙氣與洗液交換熱與水分，補水需求需與排污和帶出分開。 相變將熱轉為水蒸氣焓；潮濕材料處理中，蒸發可能比顯熱更耗能。~Hot gas exchanges heat and moisture with scrubbing liquid; distinguish makeup for evaporation, blowdown and carryover. Phase change transfers heat into water-vapour enthalpy; evaporation can dominate sensible heating in wet-material processing.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：蒸發水量 m=100 kg/h；假設潛熱 hfg=2257 kJ/kg。公式 P=m*hfg/3600，計算得 62.6944 kW。適用邊界：潛熱值只代表近常壓沸點示例，不模擬其他溫壓下的完整乾燥。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Evaporated water m=100 kg/h; assumed latent heat hfg=2257 kJ/kg. Formula P=m*hfg/3600 gives 62.6944 kW. Applicability: The latent heat represents a near-atmospheric boiling example, not full drying at other conditions.
units.verify: 針對「水分蒸發與補水」，做乾物質與水分收支，核對排氣含濕量及冷凝水。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Evaporation and makeup water, Close dry-solids and water balances, checking exhaust humidity and condensate. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 把材料減重全當作有機物破壞，會混淆乾燥與反應。 在「水分蒸發與補水」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Treating all weight loss as organic destruction confuses drying with reaction. Mark where this error can enter the Evaporation and makeup water flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 濕料減重表示同樣質量的有機物已被分解。~A wet-material mass decrease means the same mass of organics was degraded.
units.practice: 只將 m 改成 130 kg/h，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 62.6944 變成 81.5028 kW。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only m to 130 kg/h, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 62.6944 to 81.5028 kW. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 量測校正與反應證據~Calibration and reaction evidence
units.mechanism: pH、導電度和污染分析各自回應不同物理量；單一感測器正常不代表全部正常。 零點誤差與斜率誤差對不同濃度的影響不同，單點校正不能分開識別兩者。~pH, conductivity and pollutant analysis measure different quantities; one normal sensor does not validate the whole process. Offset and slope errors affect different concentrations differently; a single calibration point cannot identify both.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：參考濃度 C=50；儀器響應 y=1.08*C+2。公式 bias=y-C，計算得 6 concentration units。適用邊界：假想線性響應，濃度單位前後一致；不外推至非線性量程。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Reference concentration C=50; instrument response y=1.08*C+2. Formula bias=y-C gives 6 concentration units. Applicability: Hypothetical linear response with common concentration units; do not extrapolate into nonlinear ranges.
units.verify: 針對「量測校正與反應證據」，用空白及至少兩個非零參考點檢查殘差，保留獨立查核樣。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Calibration and reaction evidence, Use blanks and at least two nonzero references to inspect residuals, retaining an independent check standard. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 只修正零點會留下隨濃度增加的斜率偏差。 在「量測校正與反應證據」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Correcting offset alone leaves concentration-dependent slope error. Mark where this error can enter the Calibration and reaction evidence flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 零點校正正確就保證所有量程的讀值都正確。~A correct zero guarantees correct readings across the whole range.
units.practice: 只將 C 改成 100，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 6 變成 10 concentration units。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only reference C to 100, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 6 to 10 concentration units. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

units.title: 異常負荷與暫存能力~Upset loading and holding capacity
units.mechanism: 在模擬中增加入口或排污波動，檢查液槽儲量和後段負荷是否超出假設。 儲量變化等於流入減流出的時間積分；尖峰可能超過平均設計流量。~Increase inlet or blowdown variability in simulation and examine liquid storage and downstream load assumptions. Storage change is the time integral of inflow minus outflow; peaks can exceed average design flow.
units.model: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：流入 Qin=30 m³/h；排出 Qout=20 m³/h；持續 t=4 h。公式 dV=(Qin-Qout)*t，計算得 40 m³。適用邊界：固定流量時段與已知初始儲量，不含蒸發或滲漏。~Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Inflow Qin=30 m³/h; outflow Qout=20 m³/h; duration t=4 h. Formula dV=(Qin-Qout)*t gives 40 m³. Applicability: Constant flows over the interval and known initial storage; evaporation and leaks are omitted.
units.verify: 針對「異常負荷與暫存能力」，比較液位曲線導出的儲量與泵流量積分，測試假想停泵事件的容量餘裕。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。~For Upset loading and holding capacity, Compare level-derived storage with integrated pump flows and test capacity margin under a hypothetical pump outage. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
units.failure: 只用日平均流量會忽略短時暴雨造成的積存。 在「異常負荷與暫存能力」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。~Daily mean flow misses storage needed during short storm peaks. Mark where this error can enter the Upset loading and holding capacity flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
units.misconception: 日平均流入小於日平均排出就保證任何時刻都不溢流。~Lower mean inflow than outflow guarantees no overflow at any time.
units.practice: 只將 Qin 改成 40 m³/h，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 40 變成 80 m³。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。~Change only Qin to 40 m³/h, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 40 to 80 m³. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.
